scope: Global reference data only (chemical names, identifiers, classes, Pan-ReDU snapshot). No study result is stored here.

refmet_db.csv.role: RefMet super/main/sub class table read by the Annotation tab

refmet_all_ids_rest_20260929.json.role: RefMet identifier records used by FAIR evidence

code_distributed_names_and_flags.role: merit/data/refmet_names_20260927.txt.gz and refmet_external_id_flags_20260929.json.gz, read unchanged from the code snapshot

panredu_20261004/<study>.tsv.role: Pan-ReDU rows (7 columns) per Workbench study, exactly as build_analysis_evidence.py reads them

original_cohort_4121_study_ids.txt.role: Studies for which the Pan-ReDU snapshot is authoritative (the 9 March cohort); other studies query Pan-ReDU live

design_context_v11_20260601/<study>.json.role: Reviewed study-design labels (language-model reading + rules, frozen 1 June 2026) used by 8782 for the 4,121 cohort studies; other studies get the live rule-based reading
design_context_v11_20260601/<study>.json.source: merit-cache-workbench-full-v9/design_context (written by add_design_context_from_v11.py from the frozen v11 review sheet)

panredu_dump_20261104/<study>.tsv.role: Pan-ReDU rows (7 columns) per Workbench study outside the original 4,121-study cohort, from the frozen Pan-ReDU dump; a study absent from the dump has no rows. Cohort studies keep the 4 Oct 2026 snapshot (8782).
